claim.claim-text: 1. A camera (20) to which an interchangeable lens apparatus (10) is connectable via at least one adapter apparatus (30, 40), the camera (20) comprising:

a lens-camera communication controller (205, 207) configured to communicate with the interchangeable lens apparatus (10) by using a camera-lens communication channel (100); and an adapter-camera communication controller (205, 209) configured to communicate with the adapter apparatus (30, 40) by using a camera-adapter communication channel (300) provided separately from the camera-lens communication channel (100), wherein the camera-lens communication channel (100) includes a first data communication line (DLC, DCL) used during a data communication and a first notification line (LCLK) used for a notification of a timing of a communication between the camera and the interchangeable lens apparatus, wherein the camera-adapter communication channel (300) consists of a second data communication line (DATA) used during the data communication and a second notification line (CS) that is used for a notification of a timing of a communication between the camera and the adapter apparatus and is provided separately from the first notification line (LCLK).

2. The camera according to claim 1, wherein the lens-camera communication controller (205, 207) can perform the communication regardless of whether the adapter-camera communication controller (205, 209) is communicating or not.

3. The camera according to any one of claims 1 or 2, wherein the communication via the lens-camera communication channel (200) and the communication via the camera-adapter communication channel (300) are different from each other in at least one of communication method, communication timing, communication rate and communication voltage.

4. The camera according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the lens-camera communication controller transmits a lens control command for controlling an operation of the interchangeable lens apparatus, to the interchangeable lens apparatus.
5. The camera according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller receives unique information of the adapter apparatus from the adapter apparatus.
6. The camera according to claim 5, wherein the unique information includes optical data of the adapter apparatus.

7. The camera according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller receives operation data indicating a user operation for the adapter apparatus, from the adapter apparatus.

8. The camera according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the lens-camera communication controller detects a communication voltage used by the interchangeable lens apparatus in the camera-lens communication channel, and sets the communication voltage to be used for the communication with the interchangeable lens apparatus in the camera-lens communication channel according to a result of the detection.

9. The camera according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller receives data relating to the interchangeable lens apparatus from the interchangeable lens apparatus via the camera-adapter communication channel.

10. The camera according to any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein each of the lens-camera communication controller and the adapter-camera communication controller individually performs a communication to transfer the interchangeable lens apparatus and the adapter apparatus from a first state in which the communication is performed to a second state in which no communication is performed.

11. The camera according to claim 10, wherein the lens-camera communication controller transmits a lens activation signal for transferring the interchangeable lens apparatus from the second state to the first state, or a lens activation requesting signal for requesting the second state of the interchangeable lens apparatus output from the interchangeable lens apparatus to the first state, via the camera-lens communication channel, by a communication method different from the communication in the first state.

12. The camera according to claim 10 or 11, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller transmits an adapter activation signal for transferring the adapter apparatus from the second state to the first state, or an adapter activation requesting signal for requesting the second state of the adapter apparatus output from the adapter apparatus to the first state, via the camera-adapter communication channel, by a communication method different from the communication in the first state.

13. The camera according to any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller is configured to switch between a first communication method used to communicate among the interchangeable lens apparatus, the at least one adapter apparatus, and the camera, and a second communication method used to individually communicate with either the interchangeable lens apparatus or the at least one adapter apparatus and different from the first communication method in voltage level of the second notification line while transmitting data to a communication counterpart.

14. The camera according to claim 13, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller sets the voltage level of the second notification line during a data transmission in the first communication method to a first level, and sets the voltage level of the second notification line during a data transmission in the second communication method to a second level higher than the first level.

15. The camera according to claim 13 or 14, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller transmits, via the second data communication line in the first communication method, communication counterpart designation data indicating a communication counterpart of the camera in the second communication method.
16. A camera system comprising:

the camera (20) according to any one of claims 1 to 15; and an interchangeable lens apparatus (10) connected to the camera; and an adapter apparatus (30, 40) connected to the camera and the interchangeable lens apparatus.
17. An adapter apparatus (30, 40) to which a camera (20) and an interchangeable lens apparatus (10) are connectable, the adapter apparatus comprising:

a relay channel for forming part of a camera-lens communication channel (100) used for a communication between the camera and the interchangeable lens apparatus; and an adapter-camera communication controller (310, 410) configured to communicate with the camera by using a camera-adapter communication channel (300) provided separately from the relay channel, wherein the camera-lens communication channel includes a first data communication line (DCL, DLC) used during a data communication and a first notification line (LCLK) used for a notification of a timing of a communication between the camera and the interchangeable lens apparatus, wherein the camera-adapter communication channel (300) consists of a second data communication line (DATA) used during a data communication and a second notification line (CS) that is used for a notification of a timing of a communication between the camera and the adapter apparatus and is provided separately from the first notification line.

18. The adapter apparatus according to claim 17, wherein the adapter-camera communication controller (310, 410) can communicate regardless of whether the communication via the camera-lens communication channel (100) is performed or not.
19. An interchangeable lens apparatus (10) connectable to a camera (20) , the interchangeable lens apparatus comprising:

a first lens-camera communication controller (114, 115) configured to communicate with the camera by using a first communication channel (100) connected to the interchangeable lens from the camera; and a second lens-camera communication controller (114, 117) provided separately from the first communication channel and configured to communicate with the camera by using a second communication channel, wherein the first communication channel includes a first data communication line (DLC, DCL) used during a data communication and a first notification line (LCLK) used for a notification of a timing of a communication between the camera and the interchangeable lens apparatus, wherein the second communication channel consists of a second data communication line (DATA) used during a data communication and a second notification line (CS) that is used for a notification of a timing of a communication and is provided separately from the first notification line.

20. The interchangeable lens according to claim 19, wherein the first lens-camera communication controller (114, 115) can communicate regardless of whether the second lens-camera communication controller (114, 117) is communicating or not.
21. A control method for a camera (20) connected to an interchangeable lens apparatus (10) via at least one adapter apparatus (30, 40), the control method comprising the steps of:

communicating with the interchangeable lens apparatus by using a camera-lens communication channel (100), and communicating with the adapter apparatus by using a camera-adapter communication channel (300) provided separately from a camera-lens communication channel (100); and controlling an operation of the interchangeable lens apparatus using data obtained through a communication with the interchangeable lens apparatus, and controlling an operation of the adapter apparatus using data obtained through a communication with the adapter apparatus, wherein the camera-lens communication channel includes a first data communication line (DLC, DCL) used during a data communication and a first notification line (LCLK) used for a notification of a timing of a communication between the camera and the interchangeable lens apparatus, wherein the camera-adapter communication channel consists of a second data communication line (DATA) used during a data communication and a second notification line (CS) that is used for a notification of a timing of communication between the camera and the adapter apparatus and is provided separately from the first notification line.

22. A computer program for causing a computer in a camera (20) connected to an interchangeable lens apparatus (10) via at least one adapter apparatus (30, 40) to execute the control method according to claim 21.
